svg.text: Data: docs/results/store.json, 2026-10-22. Host: AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads, 8g per server.
PostgreSQL 18.6, pg_sift 3.2, Elasticsearch 9.5.5, ClickHouse 26.9.19.9, Citus 14.2-1. Questions that finish in about a millisecond have
nothing left to split across CPUs. PostgreSQL Q10 takes 23x as long at 3 CPUs: the planner chose a different plan.
